# FINAL — Full-stack API integration matrix

**Date:** 2026-11-22 · **Generated by:** `node scripts/api-integration-matrix.mjs --md` (re-run after any API or frontend change) · **Status keys:** PASS / FIXED / BLOCKED_EXTERNAL / FAIL / NOT_APPLICABLE

## 1. Summary

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| OpenAPI document current? (`pnpm --filter @meki/api openapi:export` → no diff) | **PASS** — 217 paths / 256 operations |
| Frontend call sites resolved (web + admin; literal, template, ternary and union-typed paths, local path builders) | web 32 · admin 198 |
| Call sites **without** a backend route (method + path) | **0 — PASS** |
| Backend operations used by a frontend | 204 of 256 |
| Backend operations not called by a frontend | 52 (classified in §4) |

Static analysis cannot see a path assembled entirely at run time; none remain in `apps/*/src` after the path-builder inlining. The matrix was cross-checked by the live journeys (§5).

## 2. Auth, session, cookies, CORS across the three hosts

| Topic | Design | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Admin session | HttpOnly cookie `__Host-meki_admin_sid` (Secure, SameSite=Strict, no Domain) issued by the API through the **same origin** `admin.meki-us.org/api/v1` (nginx routes it straight to 127.0.0.1:6666; the Next.js rewrite is the fallback) | PASS (local staging + browsers) |
| CSRF | `X-CSRF-Token` header on every mutation, token in memory only, refreshed once on `CSRF_INVALID` | PASS (API tests) |
| Forced password change | API refuses every route except me/csrf/logout/password-change while `mustChangePassword`; admin now renders the change form on every page | **FIXED** (was a dead end — §3) |
| Website → API | Browser calls `https://api.meki-us.org/api/v1` (public endpoints only, no cookies); `CORS_ORIGINS=https://meki-us.org,https://admin.meki-us.org`; SSR uses `API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:6666/api/v1` | PASS (config validated at API start: no http/localhost origins in production) |
| Proxy trust | One nginx hop on every host → `TRUST_PROXY=1` | PASS (config) |
| Admin production 404 | Root cause (Phase 13A): rewrite compiled without `ADMIN_API_UPSTREAM` → `http://localhost:4000`. Fixed at the source: hosted builds fail without an https, non-local upstream; on the VPS nginx serves `/api/v1` directly. | **FIXED in code/config — not verified on the deployed domain** (no access; do not claim until checked on `https://admin.meki-us.org`) |

## 3. Gaps found and fixed in this pass

| Gap | Impact | Fix | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| No admin UI for `POST /admin/auth/password/change` | First Super Admin from `admin:bootstrap` (and any reset/new user) is `mustChangePassword=true` → every page showed "forbidden"; production dashboard unusable | `features/account/{AccountGate,ChangePasswordForm,AccountPasswordPage}.tsx`, header "Change password", `/account/password` | **FIXED** |
| A wrong current password (401) signed the user out | Bad UX / lost form | `lib/api.ts` no longer broadcasts 401 for `/admin/auth/password/change` | **FIXED** |
| No admin UI for users/roles (`/admin/users*`, `/admin/roles`) | No way to create the **second approver** required by four-eyes SDI report/evidence approval → payments could never be verified in production | `features/users/UsersPage.tsx` (list/search/filter, create with roles + temporary password, edit roles, (de)activate, role catalogue), nav item now real | **FIXED** |
| Gala book/donate pages useless with API offline | Visitors blocked | Official-form hand-off (switch, default OFF) — see FINAL_ZEFFY_INTEGRATION_REPORT | **FIXED** |

## 4. Backend operations not used by a frontend — classification

| Class | Operations | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Infrastructure / machine-to-machine | `GET /health`, `GET /health/live`, `POST /webhooks/{provider}`, `POST /integrations/zeffy/webhook`, `GET /media/{path}` (served as image URLs, not fetched by code) | NOT_APPLICABLE |
| Used by e-mail links, downloads or server rendering outside the scanned call helpers | `GET /public/bookings/{reference}/confirmation`, `…/tickets/{ticketNumber}/pdf`, `GET /public/donations/{reference}/confirmation`, `…/receipt`, `GET /public/events/{slug}/calendar.ics` | NOT_APPLICABLE (link targets) |
| Public list endpoints superseded by the aggregated `/public/home` | `GET /public/site`, `/public/donation-config`, `/public/programmes`, `/public/campaigns`, `/public/statistics`, `/public/faqs`, `/public/events`, `/public/events/{slug}/campaigns` | NOT_APPLICABLE (API consumers / future use) |
| Admin event lifecycle beyond the single seeded Gala event (create/delete/submit/approve/publish/cancel/complete/archive/gallery/campaigns/sections order) | 15 operations under `/admin/events…` | Open — Gala is edited through Gala Settings; generic event management is not in the approved scope. Publishing the Gala event requires an admin with `events.publish` through the API (documented in the runbook) |
| Admin features without UI (outside urgent scope) | password reset request/confirm (needs mail), role-permission editing, permissions list, user detail, donor edit/anonymize, receipts issue/regenerate/document, payment provider/currency settings, webhook retry, payments report, donation settings, CMS section / statistic detail GETs, ticketing POST, jobs/run, system status | Open — not blocking launch; recorded for the next phase |
